meta_description: Elecsafe (NW) Ltd is a trusted electrician in Liverpool. Domestic and commercial electrical work, rewires, inspections, and emergency repairs. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: NICEIC Approved — Fast, Reliable Electrical Work
hero_subhead: From faulty sockets to full rewires, we handle all electrical work safely and on time across Liverpool.
services_subhead: We specialise in residential and commercial electrical installations, repairs, testing, and emergency callouts.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Power cuts, blown circuits, faulty sockets—we respond quickly any time of day. No job too small.

services.title: Domestic Rewires
services.desc: Full rewires for older properties bring your home up to modern safety standards and increase insurance compliance.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: Installation and repair of electrical components for boilers, heat pumps, and heating systems.

services.title: Periodic Testing & Inspections
services.desc: EICR reports and safety checks for landlords, tenants, and commercial premises—essential for compliance.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades

about_pullquote: We don't cut corners—every job is done right, first time.
about_para_1: Elecsafe (NW) Ltd has been serving Liverpool's homes and businesses for over 18 years. We started because we saw too many poorly executed electrical jobs costing homeowners money and creating safety risks. Today, we're known across Liverpool for straightforward advice, honest pricing, and work we stand behind.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we turn up on time, explain what we're doing, and don't oversell. We're NICEIC Approved, which means every installation meets Building Regulations. Whether it's a simple repair or a complete rewire, you get the same level of care and attention.

reviews.text: Called them about a fault with my consumer unit and got an appointment within two days. Lad who came was polite, knew his stuff, and explained everything clearly. Fixed it properly without trying to sell me extras. Fair price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We had a full rewire done last summer. The team were efficient, tidy, and kept us informed every step. They sorted out some dodgy wiring from a previous job and brought everything up to regs. Brilliant service, fair pricing. Already recommended them to friends.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out at 10pm on a Saturday—power tripped and wouldn't reset. They came out the same evening and had it diagnosed in minutes. Turned out to be a faulty outlet. Fixed and tested, all sorted. No nonsense, no huge bill. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: James D.
